title: Read-only gate-exposure matrix for chain PRs

steps.text: Read mission; establish real remotes (origin=github mcpdev80), cleanliness baseline
ls-remote develop tip + list PRs #1856 #1812 #1819 #1820 #1818 #1833 #1855 #1650 #1842 with head SHAs, base, state, mergeable
Compute per-candidate changed-file set via git diff --name-status origin/develop...head
Read scripts/pr-gate-plan.py on develop and on heads that change it (1856,1842); derive runtime_required/integration_required/public_contracts_required/native include + decide file:line
Compute matrix: write-set class | 3 booleans | native include | 'PR Demo Pin' executes? | evidence (file:line)
Cross-check against real PR runs (per_page=100 incl attempts): name executed vs skipped; explain disagreements vs hypothesis (trusted-base planner ci.yml:865-876)
Answer decision question (a) who NEEDS ci.yml:1080 clause, (b) already-admitted, (c) could clause manufacture red on non-resolvable pin via pr-check-runner.py:467-521
AKTE: gh pr create against live main, report PR number (no merge); zero-mutation ls-remote before/after; cleanliness line; post END_DONE
